sector_basis: Invented scenario tags for testing filters.

product.value: An annotated borrowing flow with reminders to inspect tools at return.

customers.value: Imagined members describing how they plan infrequent repair projects.

team.value: The scenario team reviews interview notes to distinguish tool access from instruction needs.

limitations: Entirely invented for demonstration; not an anonymized real company.
Dates and metrics are illustrative. No outcome, growth or survival is asserted.

preparation_lessons.title: Review customer needs through structured conversations
preparation_lessons.approach: Ask a small group about a recent task, document the obstacles they describe, and identify a question to test next.
preparation_lessons.interpretation: An original illustrative learning prompt, not a conclusion drawn from real startup history.
preparation_lessons.caution: Fictional scenario: no observed outcome, survival evidence or predictive value. Choose your own scope and decision criteria.
